item.ptxt: If communication between SUZUKI scan tool and ECM is not possible, perform the following checks:
Check communication condition between PC and VCI using SUZUKI scan tool function.
Check DLC power circuit and ground circuit.
Check CAN communication circuit and connectors between DLC and central gateway control module. (Refer to “Diagnosis flow: [a]” in “Troubleshooting” of “Troubleshooting for Lost Communication”.)
Check DLC cable. If necessary, check DLC cable by substituting a known-good DLC cable.
Check CAN communication system. (“Control Module Communication Bus Off” is detected in any control module.)
Check central gateway control module power supply circuit and ground circuit.
Check ECM power circuit and ground circuit.
With the generic scan tool, only data with asterisk (*) in the following table can be read.

When checking data with engine running at idle or racing, place gear shift lever in neutral position (M/T model) or select P range (A/T model) and apply parking brake lever fully. Also, if nothing or “no load” is indicated, turn off A/C, all electric loads, P/S and all the other switches.

topic.title: Engine Oil Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the oil temperature detected by oil temperature sensor.

topic.title: Fuel System (Fuel system status)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/F feedback control by ECM.

item.ptxt: Fuel injection time (volume) in the various engine states is determined beforehand.
Therefore, information from HO2S-1 is not reflected in fuel injection control.
Information from HO2S-1 is reflected in fuel injection control.

When ECM judges that actual air-fuel ratio is higher than stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, ECM controls to increase the volume of fuel. On the contrary, when the actual air-fuel ratio is lower than stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, ECM controls to decrease the volume of fuel.

topic.title: Short Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates short term fuel trim value (short term air/fuel mixture correction factor) and changes the value corresponding to driving conditions. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Long Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates a median value of short term trim learned in A/F feedback control (closed loop). This median value is used by ECM to correct fuel injection volume appropriately in open loop control avoiding interference caused by individual difference and aging. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Total Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the comprehensive fuel trim computed based on short term and long term fuel trim.

topic.title: Inj Pulse Width (Fuel injection pulse width, msec)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the injector drive pulse width (open time) during the injector valve stays open commanded by ECM.

topic.title: Ignition Advance (Ignition timing advance for No.1 cylinder, ° BTDC)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the ignition timing of No.1 cylinder commanded by ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Rail Pressure (kPa, mmHg, inHg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates fuel rail pressure measured by fuel pressure sensor.

topic.title: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (kPa, mmHg, inHg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates target fuel rail pressure calculated by ECM.

topic.title: Calculated Load (Calculated load value, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the engine load as a percentage calculated by ECM based on input signals of various sensors.

topic.title: Engine Speed (rpm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the engine speed calculated by ECM based on input signal of CKP sensor.

topic.title: Desired Idle (Desired idle speed, rpm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the target engine idle speed requested by ECM.

attention3.ptxt: When performing “Fixed Spark” in “Active Test”, actual engine idle speed may not follow the target engine idle speed.

topic.title: MAF (Mass air flow rate, g/sec, lb/min.)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the total mass of air entering intake manifold measured by MAF sensor.

topic.title: Vehicle Speed (km/h, MPH)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the vehicle speed based on signals from wheel speed sensors sent from ESP® control module via CAN communication.

topic.title: MAP (Manifold absolute pressure, kPa, mmHg, inHg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated MAP based on input voltage of MAP sensor.

topic.title: ECT (Engine coolant temperature, °C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated ECT based on input voltage of ECT sensor.

topic.title: Intake Air Temperature 2 (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated IAT based on input voltage of intake air temperature sensor-2.

topic.title: Barometric Pres (Barometric pressure, kPa, mmHg, inHg, psi, inH2O)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the barometric air pressure measurement and is used for altitude correction of the fuel injection rate.

topic.title: Evap Canist Prg Duty (Evap canister purge flow duty, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates valve ON (valve open) time rate within a certain set cycle of EVAP canister purge valve.

topic.title: Waste Gate Valve - VSV control duty (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates valve ON (VSV open) time rate within a certain set cycle of WGV-VSV which controls the WGV opening.

topic.title: VVT Gap (Variable valve timing difference between target and actual position, °)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates difference between target camshaft position (intake side) and actual camshaft position (intake side).

topic.title: IAC Throttle Opening (Idle air throttle valve opening, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates opening% of throttle valve on the assumption that the maximum opening of idle air control is 100%.

topic.title: TP Sensor 1 Volt (TP sensor (main) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of TP sensor (main) incorporated in throttle body.

topic.title: TP Sensor 2 Volt (TP sensor (sub) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of TP sensor (sub) incorporated in throttle body.

topic.title: APP Sensor 1 Voltage (APP sensor (main) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of APP sensor (main) incorporated in accelerator pedal.

topic.title: APP Sensor 2 Voltage (APP sensor (sub) output voltage, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of APP sensor (sub) incorporated in accelerator pedal.

topic.title: Accelerator Position (Absolute accelerator pedal position, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the depressing amount of accelerator pedal in percentage calculated by ECM based on the input signals of APP sensor (main and sub).

topic.title: Throttle Position (Absolute throttle position, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated throttle valve opening in percentage based on input signal from TP sensor.

topic.title: Target Throttle Posi (Target throttle valve position, %)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the target throttle position requested by ECM.

topic.title: O2S B1 S1 (HO2S-1, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage of HO2S-1 installed on exhaust manifold (pre-TWC).

topic.title: O2S B1 S2 (HO2S-2, V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage of HO2S-2 installed on exhaust manifold (post-TWC). It is used to detect catalyst deterioration.

topic.title: Battery Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery positive voltage inputted from main relay to ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Tank Level (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the information of fuel level inputted via combination meter. The fuel level data is provided as a percentage from 0 to 100%.

topic.title: A/C Pressure (A/C refrigerant absolute pressure, kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates A/C refrigerant pressure calculated by ECM based on A/C refrigerant pressure sensor voltage.

topic.title: Generator Field Duty (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates operating rate (state of output) of the generator by field coil duty ratio.

topic.title: Battery Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates electric load value (current consumption) detected by electric load current sensor.

topic.title: Battery Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery temperature based on battery temperature sensor.

topic.title: Generator Reg Volt (Com) (Generator Regulated Voltage (Com) (V))
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates commanded generator regulated voltage.

topic.title: Radiator Fan (Radiator cooling fan control relay, Low/Mid/High/Off)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state that ECM operates radiator cooling fan relays.

topic.title: A/C Comp Relay (A/C compressor relay, ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the A/C compressor relay controlled by ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Pump (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of fuel pump relay controlled by ECM.

topic.title: Air Bypass Valve (Com) (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of air bypass solenoid valve controlled by ECM.

topic.title: Starter Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates state of starting motor control relay output.

topic.title: A/C Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/C operation controlled by ECM based on request from BCM.

topic.title: Blower Fan (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the signal state of the blower fan motor inputted into ECM.

topic.title: Brake Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates operating state of the brake switch.

topic.title: Electric Load (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of electric load signal inputted into ECM.

topic.title: PNP Signal (P/N or D range) (A/T model)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates shift position informed from TCM via CAN communication.

topic.title: Clutch Switch (CPP No.2 switch, Declutch/Clutched) (M/T model)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates operating state of CPP No.2 switch.

topic.title: Cruise RES/ACC Switch (“RES/+” switch, OFF/ON)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of cruise “RES/+” switch.

topic.title: Cruise SET/COAST Switch (“SET/–” switch, OFF/ON)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of cruise SET/–” switch.

topic.title: Cruise CANCEL Switch (“CANCEL” switch, OFF/ON)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of cruise “CANCEL” switch.

topic.title: Cruise ON/OFF Switch (“CRUISE” (main) switch, Released/Pushed)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of “CRUISE” (main) switch.

topic.title: Distance Setting Switch (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of distance switch.

topic.title: Speed Limiter Switch (“LIMIT” switch, ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of “LIMIT” switch.

topic.title: Speed Limiter (Inactive/Active)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of the speed limiter system.

topic.title: Speed Limiter Main SW (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the speed limiter system.

topic.title: Fuel Cut (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of fuel injection.

topic.title: Closed Throttle Pos (Closed throttle position, ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates monitored idle for engine control.

topic.title: O2S B1 S1 ACT (HO2S-1, Active/Inactive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of HO2S-1.

topic.title: O2S B1 S2 ACT (HO2S-2, Active/Inactive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of HO2S-2.

topic.title: Target Valve Closing Position of High Pressure Fuel Pump (°CA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates close timing of high pressure fuel pump delivery valve. Correlation between the close timing and amount of fuel supply into high-pressure fuel pipe is as follows.
0 degree: Amount of fuel supply is the minimum.
Larger degrees: Amount of fuel supply increases.

topic.title: Intake Air Temperature 1 (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated IAT based on input voltage of intake air temperature sensor-1.

topic.title: Boost Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated boost pressure based on input voltage of boost pressure sensor.
